provenance.hit_rate: 50% hit / 50% miss, misses rejection-sampled from the population's own generator and shuffled in (8.6)
provenance.core_pin_note: CPUs 0-15 are the 8 performance cores with both SMT siblings, so the 16-thread cell runs two threads per physical core; it is not 16 independent cores
provenance.load_snapshot_method: /proc/stat jiffy delta between consecutive snapshots, in core-equivalents (section 8.17)

estimators.ratio: scaling_vs_1t = mean(Mops/s at W threads) / mean(Mops/s at 1 thread), two-sample BCa
estimators.columns: mean_mops is the mean of per-round throughput; ci95_mops is its one-sample BCa 95% interval
estimators.raw: rounds_raw carries every per-round Mops/s the summary was computed from

distribution_census.method: n=60 rounds per cell, pinned, same host and commit; a cell counts as unimodal when cv <= 25% and no round exceeds 1.5x the median

provenance.pin_exposure_note: The superseded artifact was measured unpinned; exposure runs from parity at one thread to 5.6x at sixteen, so its within-arm scaling curve is invalid as well as its absolutes (#774)

discarded_runs.what: an earlier unsnapshotted pin A/B and one repetition of it
discarded_runs.why: the repetition ran inside another session's masstree_comparison sweep on the same host; discarded as contaminated rather than averaged in (8.17)
discarded_runs.superseded_by: the snapshotted re-take recorded under pin_exposure

statistics.note: Per-round samples are emitted so a published scaling factor can carry a BCa interval; this harness reports means and leaves the interval to scripts/bca_bootstrap.py (AGENTS.md 8.4).
